title: MicroMacro: Crime City
subtitle: Cooperative visual deduction across a giant, intricate black-and-white city map
tagline: Uncover hidden crimes in the streets of Crime City
loreSummary: Crime City is teeming with clandestine deals, petty pickpockets, and brazen heists. Armed with a magnifying glass, your team pores over a massive city map to reconstruct timelines, trace suspects, and solve 16 interconnected mysteries.
roadmapTitle: 🔎 Crime City Case Chronicles & Map Progression
keyFeatures: Innovative spatial-temporal deduction across a giant 75x110 cm hand-drawn city canvas
Simultaneous event tracking where characters appear across multiple moments in time
16 distinct case files spanning 5 difficulty tiers from introductory to mastermind
Spiel des Jahres 2021 Game of the Year award-winning gameplay

micromacro_full_investigation.name: All 16 Crime City Cases
micromacro_full_investigation.description: The complete base-game investigation tracking all 16 cases from 1-star starters to the 5-star finale.

micromacro_introductory_cases.name: Starter Detective Arc (First 5 Cases)
micromacro_introductory_cases.description: An introductory set of accessible 1-star and 2-star cases ideal for casual detective evenings.

micromacro_complex_mysteries.name: Master Sleuth Complex Cases (Stars 3–5)
micromacro_complex_mysteries.description: The most challenging half of Crime City featuring intricate routes, deceptive alibis, and subtle clues.

milestones.title: First Steps in Crime City
milestones.description: Armed with a magnifying glass, detectives unravel their first street-corner mystery, tracking suspects backward in time across the map.

milestones.title: Following the Getaway
milestones.description: Tracing vehicular paths and suspicious characters across busy traffic hubs, train stations, and bustling storefronts.

milestones.title: Midtown Intrigues
milestones.description: Multi-card investigations challenge the group to deduce hidden motives and unmask accomplices hiding in plain sight.

milestones.title: Syndicate Schemes
milestones.description: Complex 4-star investigations where timelines crisscross and suspects disguise their movements across distant city quarters.

milestones.title: The Master Detective's Ledger
milestones.description: The concluding 5-star brainteaser that tests the keenest eyes and deductive prowess across every corner of Crime City.
